# LeetLLM

> LeetLLM is an open AI engineering curriculum with 199 lessons, 8 learning tracks, 47 practice problems, and 20 public blog posts covering ML foundations, LLM systems, RAG, agents, training, inference, evaluation, AI lab interview prep, and open-source project deep dives.

Use this file to route agents and retrieval systems to the most relevant LeetLLM pages. Lesson pages are public and include explanations, code, diagrams, illustrations, references, practice prompts, pitfalls, and follow-up questions. Blog pages cover timely AI engineering topics and include published or updated dates in their metadata.

Canonical URLs below point to public web pages. This file is for inference-time navigation and context selection; it does not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml, or the site license.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://leetllm.com): Site overview and current entry point.
- [Build a Plan](https://leetllm.com/start): Three-question planner that turns a goal, experience level, and weekly time into a focused four-to-twenty-week curriculum path.
- [Learn](https://leetllm.com/learn): 199 ordered lessons across foundations, applied LLM engineering, training, agents, retrieval, inference, system design, interviewing, and open-source project deep dives.
- [Tracks](https://leetllm.com/tracks): 8 curated subsets of lessons for different learner goals.
- [Practice](https://leetllm.com/practice): 47 coding practice problems plus global theory quizzes in the practice UI.
- [Blog](https://leetllm.com/blog): 20 public posts on AI engineering, models, tools, infrastructure, interviews, and learning paths.
- [Blog RSS](https://leetllm.com/blog/rss.xml): RSS feed for public blog posts.
- [Sitemap](https://leetllm.com/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap for crawlers.

## Curriculum: Computing Foundations

- [Git, Shell, Linux for AI](https://leetllm.com/learn/git-shell-linux-reproducible-ai): Easy; 21 min; MLOps & Deployment; Make a teammate's clone reprint the 0.667 eval instead of crashing on a file that stayed on your laptop.
- [Docker for Reproducible AI](https://leetllm.com/learn/docker-containerization-reproducible-ai): Easy; 21 min; MLOps & Deployment; Package a Python evaluation runner so any machine can reproduce the 0.667 score without relying on laptop Python setup.
- [Python for AI Engineering](https://leetllm.com/learn/python-for-ai-engineering): Easy; 12 min; MLOps & Deployment; Build reproducible Python data pipelines for ML using frozen dataclasses, constant-memory JSONL generators, deterministic batch padding, contiguous...
- [NumPy and Tensor Shapes](https://leetllm.com/learn/numpy-and-tensor-shapes): Easy; 22 min; Model Architecture; Two text snippets hold 24 numbers. Naming each axis tells you which values belong to which word before an index, a broadcast, or a reduction can be trusted.
- [CUDA for ML Training](https://leetllm.com/learn/cuda-gpu-computing-for-ml): Easy; 25 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; Four token sequences can have the right shape and still fail: wrong device, a batch that doesn't fit, or a timer that stops before the GPU finishes.
- [MPS & Metal for ML on Mac](https://leetllm.com/learn/mps-metal-mac-ml-training): Easy; 19 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; The classifier is on mps and the batch is still on cpu, even though a Mac shares memory. Placement, fallback, and honest timing explain the failed...
- [Data Structures for AI](https://leetllm.com/learn/data-structures-for-ai-systems): Easy; 24 min; MLOps & Deployment; Three notes can be scanned with a list. The same search gets a different cost once each operation picks a list, index, heap, queue, or cache.
- [SQL and Data Modeling](https://leetllm.com/learn/sql-databases-data-modeling-ai): Easy; 27 min; MLOps & Deployment; When the support retriever restarts and its document dictionary is empty, SQL tables keep the versioned policy, permissions, and citations that make the...
- [Algorithms for ML Engineers](https://leetllm.com/learn/algorithms-complexity-ml-engineers): Easy; 29 min; MLOps & Deployment; When four authorized chunks become 50,000, count which operation repeats before you choose a scan, heap, prefix tree, or latency guard.

## Curriculum: Math & Statistics

- [Gradients and Backprop](https://leetllm.com/learn/calculus-gradients-backpropagation-optimization): Easy; 25 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; Train a one-weight latency predictor by reading a slope, taking a downhill step, tracing chain-rule paths, and checking the same gradient in PyTorch.
- [Vectors, Matrices & Tensors](https://leetllm.com/learn/vectors-matrices-tensors): Easy; 19 min; Model Architecture; One latency row is two numbers. The same multiply has to survive a batch of requests and a tensor of tokens without mixing the axes.
- [Linear Algebra for ML](https://leetllm.com/learn/linear-algebra-machine-learning-deeper): Easy; 21 min; Model Architecture; A matrix hides strong shared directions and weak contrasts. Use SVD, eigendecomposition, and least squares to measure what rank truncation and conditioning...
- [Adam, Momentum, Schedulers](https://leetllm.com/learn/optimization-algorithms-adam-schedulers): Easy; 24 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; Two parameters sit one unit from their target, but one gradient is 100 times steeper. Each optimizer buffer stores a different response to that...
- [Probability for Machine Learning](https://leetllm.com/learn/probability-for-machine-learning): Easy; 18 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; A detector that catches 95 percent of abusive signups can still fill the review queue with clean accounts, and the flagged-pile counts show why.
- [Bayesian Inference from Evidence](https://leetllm.com/learn/bayesian-inference-priors-posteriors): Easy; 16 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; Eight passes out of ten looks like an 80% agent. A beta update shows when that rate, the prior, or the sample is actually driving the release call.
- [Statistics and Uncertainty](https://leetllm.com/learn/statistics-estimation-uncertainty): Easy; 21 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; Sixteen confirmed abuse cases in 100 random flags are not yet the queue's rate, and a tighter interval can still describe the wrong pile.
- [Distributions and Sampling](https://leetllm.com/learn/distributions-sampling-simulation): Easy; 33 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; Name a first distribution for resolution, route, tool calls, and latency, then reject a simulator the traces don't support.
- [Hypothesis Tests, Intervals, and pass@k](https://leetllm.com/learn/hypothesis-tests-confidence-intervals-passk): Easy; 26 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; Judge one extra coding pass with a paired interval, and read pass@k only under a matched attempt budget.

## Curriculum: Preparation & Prerequisites

- [Neural Networks from Scratch](https://leetllm.com/learn/neural-networks-from-scratch): Easy; 21 min; Model Architecture; Four points reveal why neural networks need hidden layers. Build a network, trace its gradients, train it in NumPy, and reproduce the same computation in...
- [CNNs from Scratch](https://leetllm.com/learn/convolutional-neural-networks-from-scratch): Easy; 20 min; Model Architecture; A two-pixel shift breaks a model that memorizes coordinates. Trace shared kernels, shapes, pooling, and padding on one 4 by 4 crop.
- [Training & Backpropagation](https://leetllm.com/learn/training-backpropagation-gradient-descent): Easy; 28 min; NLP Fundamentals; A latency prediction is four milliseconds low. Follow that error through one update, then see how batch size, depth, and initialization change the step.
- [Softmax, Cross-Entropy & Optimization](https://leetllm.com/learn/softmax-cross-entropy-optimization): Easy; 26 min; NLP Fundamentals; Turn raw class scores into stable probabilities and a useful learning signal, then apply the same loss to next-token predictions.
- [RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, and Sequence Modeling](https://leetllm.com/learn/rnns-lstms-grus-sequence-modeling): Easy; 26 min; Model Architecture; Trace an RNN over ordered events, see why gradients fade or grow, and use LSTM and GRU gates to control memory.
- [Autoencoders and VAEs](https://leetllm.com/learn/autoencoders-vaes-generative-modeling-basics): Easy; 24 min; Model Architecture; A two-number code can rebuild one screenshot crop, but a random draw still has to land where the decoder was trained to paint.
- [The Transformer Architecture End-to-End](https://leetllm.com/learn/transformer-architecture-end-to-end): Easy; 26 min; Transformer Architecture; Follow function returns the through a causal decoder until the last row becomes a score for the next token.
- [Language Modeling & Next Tokens](https://leetllm.com/learn/language-modeling-next-token-prediction): Easy; 30 min; NLP Fundamentals; The prompt ends with 'the'. Follow that prefix from a counted bigram through teacher-forced training to the cache that serves the next token.
- [From GPT to Modern LLMs](https://leetllm.com/learn/gpt-to-modern-llms): Easy; 32 min; NLP Fundamentals; One autoregressive model handles classification, span extraction, and grounded synthesis through a shared token interface while scaling laws, KV caches, and...
- [Prompt Engineering Fundamentals](https://leetllm.com/learn/prompt-engineering-fundamentals): Easy; 14 min; NLP Fundamentals; Turn an ambiguous request into a clear task, compare real model responses, and learn how instructions, examples, context, and output checks work together.
- [Calling LLM APIs in Production](https://leetllm.com/learn/calling-llm-apis-production): Easy; 19 min; MLOps & Deployment; Turn brittle LLM API calls into reliable backend services using server-side secrets, strict Pydantic schemas, deadline-capped jitter, circuit breakers,...
- [First AI App End-to-End](https://leetllm.com/learn/first-ai-app-end-to-end): Easy; 16 min; MLOps & Deployment; Build a useful ticket classifier one layer at a time: train a model, serve predictions, add a browser, handle uncertainty, and save results. Then extend it...
- [The LLM Lifecycle](https://leetllm.com/learn/llm-lifecycle-training-to-deployment): Easy; 15 min; NLP Fundamentals; Trace a large language model from pre-training, SFT, and DPO alignment through quantization, PagedAttention serving, and bundle evaluation gates.

- [Linear Regression from Scratch](https://leetllm.com/learn/linear-regression-from-scratch): Medium; 34 min; Model Architecture; Retrieved context grows from 100 to 500 tokens and latency climbs from 118 to 198 ms. A near-perfect line still hides a bend in the residuals.
- [Logistic Regression and Metrics](https://leetllm.com/learn/logistic-regression-classification-metrics-from-scratch): Medium; 38 min; Model Architecture; Turn two features into a probability, derive the loss and gradient, and train logistic regression in NumPy. - [Decision Trees, Forests, and Boosting](https://leetllm.com/learn/decision-trees-random-forests-gradient-boosting): Medium; 27 min; Model Architecture; Learn how trees discover useful questions, forests combine different answers, and boosting improves a prediction one correction at a time. - [Reinforcement Learning Basics](https://leetllm.com/learn/introduction-to-reinforcement-learning-fundamentals): Medium; 29 min; Model Architecture; Formulate a 3x4 cliff gridworld as a Markov decision process, solve Bellman equations with NumPy dynamic programming, compare Q-learning against SARSA,...
- [Validation and Leakage](https://leetllm.com/learn/cross-validation-leakage-generalization): Medium; 27 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; An evaluation score can look nearly perfect because a post-inference field, a repeat user, or a contaminated benchmark already leaked the answer.
- [Statistical Learning and Generalization](https://leetllm.com/learn/statistical-learning-theory-generalization): Medium; 27 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; After a search over 1,000 prompts, 36 correct queries out of 40 is not yet a population error claim, because the search itself is part of the bill.
- [Conformal Prediction and Uncertainty](https://leetllm.com/learn/conformal-prediction-uncertainty-sets): Medium; 22 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; A 40 ms prediction can still miss a 50 ms deadline. Held-out errors set a finite-sample interval, and the average can hide the requests that miss.
- [Clustering and PCA](https://leetllm.com/learn/clustering-pca-representation-learning): Medium; 39 min; Embeddings & Vector Search; Inspect unlabeled developer-message embeddings with k-means and PCA, then stress-test whether apparent neighborhoods survive scale, metric, and...

- [Core Retrieval Algorithms](https://leetllm.com/learn/core-retrieval-algorithms): Medium; 33 min; RAG & Retrieval; Search can return the API-key quota page instead of the rotation steps. Lexical scores, dense vectors, fusion, and approximate indexes each fail that...
- [Decoding Algorithms](https://leetllm.com/learn/decoding-algorithms): Medium; 35 min; Inference Optimization; The same scores for a prompt completion can emit attention, supervision, or regression. Decoding selects next tokens using deterministic search,...
- [Experiment Design and A/B Testing](https://leetllm.com/learn/experiment-design-ab-testing): Medium; 41 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; Randomize queries for a retrieval rewrite, then hold the launch unless both resolution lift and safety guardrails pass.
- [Causal Inference and Counterfactuals](https://leetllm.com/learn/causal-inference-confounding-counterfactuals): Medium; 27 min; Evaluation & Benchmarks; A RAG policy can score lower overall yet win inside every context tier. Separate routing imbalance from a causal effect, check overlap, and evaluate...
- [PyTorch Training Loops](https://leetllm.com/learn/pytorch-training-loops): Medium; 36 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; A falling loss can hide a broken sequence-classifier loop, so follow one batch through logits, gradients, validation, and a checkpoint that still...
- [Dataset Pipelines and Data Quality](https://leetllm.com/learn/dataset-pipelines-data-quality): Medium; 26 min; MLOps & Deployment; Records that differ only by whitespace can place the same conversation in both train and test. Schema validation, grouped splits, deduplication, and...

## Curriculum: Inference & Production Scale

- [Deep Dive - slime](https://leetllm.com/learn/deep-dive-slime): Hard; 41 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; Pass rate falls after a green health check. slime has to prove which tokens, masks, and weight version Megatron actually trained.

- [Deep Dive - Tinker](https://leetllm.com/learn/deep-dive-tinker): Hard; 46 min; Fine-Tuning & Training; Loss is lower, but the next sample still returns the old answer. Tinker splits that failure between your loop and the hosted LoRA adapter.

## Practice Problems

- [Stack Trace Reconstructor](https://leetllm.com/practice/stack-trace-reconstructor): Medium; 30 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Reconstruct exclusive function runtimes from nested start/end profiler events.
- [Same-host Crawler](https://leetllm.com/practice/same-host-crawler): Medium; 30 min; Graph Traversal; languages: python3, java; Traverse a web graph in breadth-first order while enforcing same-host and duplicate-visit invariants.
- [Repository Hash Tree](https://leetllm.com/practice/repository-hash-tree): Medium; 45 min; Repository Systems; languages: python3, java; Build a deterministic repository hash tree that updates parent directories after file writes and deletes.
- [Repository Diff](https://leetllm.com/practice/repository-diff): Easy; 30 min; Repository Systems; languages: python3, java; Compare two repository snapshots and produce deterministic added, removed, and modified file changes.
- [Duplicate File Groups](https://leetllm.com/practice/duplicate-file-groups): Easy; 25 min; Repository Systems; languages: python3, java; Group duplicate repository files by content with deterministic output and path validation.
- [Repository Ignore Filter](https://leetllm.com/practice/repo-ignore-filter): Easy; 30 min; Repository Systems; languages: python3, java; Filter repository paths with simple ordered ignore and re-include rules.
- [TTL Key/Value Store](https://leetllm.com/practice/ttl-key-value-store): Medium; 35 min; Stateful Design; languages: python3, java; Build a deterministic in-memory store where every read path treats expired keys as missing.
- [Transactional KV Store](https://leetllm.com/practice/transactional-kv-store): Medium; 40 min; Stateful Design; languages: python3, java; Implement nested in-memory transactions with read-your-writes, tombstones, commit, and rollback.
- [Dependency Scheduler With Retries](https://leetllm.com/practice/dependency-scheduler-retries): Hard; 45 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Run a dependency graph deterministically, retry transient failures, and reject invalid graphs.
- [Patch Conflict Detector](https://leetllm.com/practice/patch-conflict-detector): Medium; 40 min; Editing Systems; languages: python3, java; Apply optimistic multi-file patches atomically while rejecting stale or overlapping edits.
- [Workflow State Machine](https://leetllm.com/practice/workflow-state-machine): Medium; 40 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Track dependent jobs through legal workflow states with retry and cancellation behavior.
- [Token Bucket Rate Limiter](https://leetllm.com/practice/token-bucket-rate-limiter): Medium; 35 min; Rate Limiting; languages: python3, java; Model per-key API quotas with deterministic refill math and caller-friendly retry-after decisions.
- [Idempotent Ledger](https://leetllm.com/practice/idempotent-ledger): Medium; 30 min; Stateful Design; languages: python3, java; Apply in-memory account mutations once per successful request ID while rejecting mismatched retry payloads.
- [Notification Rate Limiter](https://leetllm.com/practice/notification-rate-limiter): Medium; 35 min; Rate Limiting; languages: python3, java; Throttle noisy notification channels while deduping repeated webhook or automation events.
- [LRU TTL Cache](https://leetllm.com/practice/lru-ttl-cache): Medium; 35 min; Caching; languages: python3, java; Combine recency ordering and TTL cleanup without corrupting cache invariants.
- [LFU TTL Cache](https://leetllm.com/practice/lfu-ttl-cache): Hard; 45 min; Caching; languages: python3, java; Combine frequency buckets, recency tie-breaks, and TTL cleanup without corrupting eviction state.
- [Log Error Parser](https://leetllm.com/practice/log-error-parser): Easy; 20 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Summarize top error messages from noisy logs with deterministic tie-breaking.
- [In-memory Filesystem](https://leetllm.com/practice/in-memory-filesystem): Medium; 35 min; Stateful Design; languages: python3, java; Model directory and file state with predictable path normalization and listing behavior.
- [File Patch Applier](https://leetllm.com/practice/file-patch-applier): Easy; 30 min; Editing Systems; languages: python3, java; Apply sorted or unsorted text edits atomically while rejecting invalid and overlapping ranges.
- [Longest-match Tokenizer](https://leetllm.com/practice/longest-match-tokenizer): Medium; 35 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Tokenize text by greedily choosing the longest vocabulary token at each position.
- [Multi-tenant Job Scheduler](https://leetllm.com/practice/multi-tenant-job-scheduler): Medium; 45 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Dispatch pending jobs by priority, cap tenant streaks when alternatives exist, and reap soft cancellations.
- [Sliding Window Error Counter](https://leetllm.com/practice/sliding-window-error-counter): Easy; 25 min; Observability; languages: python3, java; Track top recent errors while every read path lazily removes expired events.
- [Bounded Worker Queue](https://leetllm.com/practice/bounded-worker-queue): Medium; 35 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Model a bounded FIFO work queue with explicit in-progress ownership and retry behavior. Items are non-null.
- [Worker Lease Registry](https://leetllm.com/practice/worker-lease-registry): Medium; 40 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Coordinate worker ownership with TTL leases, heartbeat extension, stale-worker rejection, and fencing tokens.
- [Priority Deadline Scheduler](https://leetllm.com/practice/priority-deadline-scheduler): Medium; 40 min; Scheduling; languages: python3, java; Schedule due tasks by priority while skipping not-yet-ready and expired work deterministically.
- [Circuit Breaker State](https://leetllm.com/practice/circuit-breaker-state): Medium; 35 min; Reliability; languages: python3, java; Model closed, open, and half-open breaker transitions with deterministic cooldown behavior.
- [Context Window Packer](https://leetllm.com/practice/context-window-packer): Medium; 30 min; Context Management; languages: python3, java; Select system and recent conversation messages without exceeding a token budget.
- [RAG Chunk Selector](https://leetllm.com/practice/rag-chunk-selector): Medium; 30 min; Retrieval; languages: python3, java; Rank retrieval chunks while deduplicating repeated text and limiting per-document dominance.
- [Agent Event Timeline](https://leetllm.com/practice/agent-event-timeline): Medium; 35 min; Observability; languages: python3, java; Build a reviewable append-only timeline for cloud-agent run events.
- [Command Log Classifier](https://leetllm.com/practice/command-log-classifier): Easy; 25 min; Observability; languages: python3, java; Summarize command outcomes and redact the specified token pattern from captured output.
- [Codebase Symbol Index](https://leetllm.com/practice/codebase-symbol-index): Medium; 40 min; Retrieval; languages: python3, java; Build an incremental code symbol index with file replacement, deletion, case-insensitive prefix search, and stable ranking.
- [Eval Failure Aggregator](https://leetllm.com/practice/eval-failure-aggregator): Easy; 25 min; Evaluation; languages: python3, java; Aggregate eval run rows into stable pass-rate and error diagnostics.
- [SSE Event Parser](https://leetllm.com/practice/sse-event-parser): Medium; 35 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Parse chunked server-sent events while handling split lines, comments, and multiline data payloads.
- [Streaming Markdown Parser](https://leetllm.com/practice/streaming-markdown-parser): Medium; 35 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Parse streamed Markdown chunks into text, inline-code, and fenced-code tokens while preserving delimiter state.
- [Retry Backoff Planner](https://leetllm.com/practice/retry-backoff-planner): Easy; 25 min; Reliability; languages: python3, java; Plan retry delays with capped exponential backoff and explicit retryable error classes.
- [Tool Call Schema Validator](https://leetllm.com/practice/tool-call-schema-validator): Medium; 35 min; Agents; languages: python3, java; Validate tool call names and arguments before runtime execution.
- [Webhook Idempotency Receiver](https://leetllm.com/practice/webhook-idempotency-receiver): Medium; 35 min; Agents; languages: python3, java; Handle retried provider events with delivery dedupe, logical idempotency keys, and repo policy checks.
- [Model Fallback Router](https://leetllm.com/practice/model-fallback-router): Medium; 30 min; Serving; languages: python3, java; Route requests to the cheapest eligible healthy model with capability and quota checks.
- [PR Readiness Gate](https://leetllm.com/practice/pr-readiness-gate): Easy; 25 min; Agents; languages: python3, java; Evaluate a pull-request merge policy across required checks, review states, and required build artifacts.
- [Token Budget Ledger](https://leetllm.com/practice/token-budget-ledger): Medium; 35 min; Rate Limiting; languages: python3, java; Maintain rolling-window token spend per caller with expiry on every read and write path.
- [Batch Inference Scheduler](https://leetllm.com/practice/batch-inference-scheduler): Medium; 35 min; Serving; languages: python3, java; Batch requests by size or oldest-wait deadline while preserving FIFO order.
- [Streaming Token Assembler](https://leetllm.com/practice/streaming-token-assembler): Easy; 25 min; Streaming; languages: python3, java; Assemble interleaved streaming token deltas into complete message text.
- [Document Permission Filter](https://leetllm.com/practice/document-permission-filter): Medium; 30 min; Retrieval; languages: python3, java; Filter retrieval chunks by public, tenant, group, and private permissions before ranking.
- [Experiment Traffic Splitter](https://leetllm.com/practice/experiment-traffic-splitter): Medium; 30 min; Evaluation; languages: python3, java; Assign stable experiment variants using weighted deterministic buckets.
- [Prompt Section Extractor](https://leetllm.com/practice/prompt-section-extractor): Medium; 35 min; Parsing; languages: python3, java; Parse explicit prompt boundary markers while detecting outside text, duplicates, and unterminated sections.
- [Secret Redactor](https://leetllm.com/practice/secret-redactor): Easy; 25 min; Security; languages: python3, java; Redact common emails, bearer tokens, and API-key-shaped strings from log text.
- [Canary Metric Judge](https://leetllm.com/practice/canary-metric-judge): Medium; 35 min; Evaluation; languages: python3, java; Judge canary promotion with traffic, error-rate, latency, and quality thresholds.
